_doc: VTID-05093 (Health Hub D10, WP2). Wording lock for the health consent texts in src/i18n/<locale>/screens.json under screens.settings.healthConsent.<category>.<version>.{title,body,checkbox}. A version may be granted in the app ONLY when it is listed here with status "released" and a sha256 for the locale it is shown in (src/lib/health-consent-wording.ts). Released texts are owner/counsel-supplied and pasted verbatim; src/lib/health-consent-wording.vtid-05093.test.ts fails if a released text changes, so new wording needs a new version (v2) plus a catalogue current_text_version bump. sha256 = hex digest of title + "\n" + body + "\n" + checkbox. While a version is "draft" its title carries the [DRAFT] marker and the app never shows it or lets anyone grant it; withdrawing an existing consent is always possible.
